inlines.v: ANTHROPOL'OGY, noun [Gr. man, and discourse.] 1. A discourse upon human nature. 2. The doctrine of the structure of the human body; the natural history or physiology of the human species. 3. The word denotes that manner of expression by which the inspired writers attribute human parts and passions to God.
